what: A hook gate kept as evidence that the gate proves what ran: the first Python function bound at a hook (a TorchScript model run from the interpreter through a C callback, in shadow at compute_uwshcu_inv) on image p32, whose hooks module predates the packed plugin branch.
outcome: every rank stopped at its first modeled call: `pycam_hooks: the packed model block of compute_uwshcu_inv takes TorchScript models only` (512 messages, one a rank); rank 45 exited with code 128 and the model run ended before the first step
bfb_record_note: no record of the run was written; the comparison the job ran anyway against the oracle was discarded with it
diagnosis: The callback was built, bound (pycam_hooks_bind_plugin_v1) and reached: the hook took the plugged branch.  The generated module in image p32 still refuses a plugin at a packed block with an error stop; the branch that hands a plugin the one packed output (commit 167a71a1) was in the working tree but not in the image the job ran.  A live month with the same function (7511163) failed the same way and was deleted.
disposition: Image p33 (build 7511224) carries the new module; the nothing-armed gate, the callback shadow gate and the callback month are queued on it (7511229-7511231).
